queries.Context: Core platform design for proteo: PISA proteome integral solubility alteration thermal shift assay in living cells and native lysates for proteome-wide drug mechanism of action characterization, measuring compound-induced protein thermal stability changes using TMT quantitative mass spectrometry to distinguish direct binding from indirect cellular effects.
queries.Context: Cell-based thermal profiling of: cell-based proteome-wide thermal shift assay treating K562 cells with compounds, heating across 48 to 58 degrees Celsius, measuring soluble protein abundance after thermal denaturation and centrifugation to identify compound mechanism of action and off-target protein engagement
queries.Context: Lysate-based profiling of direc: PISA proteome integral solubility alteration assay in K562 lysates prepared by dounce homogenization, thermal denaturation, and TMT mass spectrometry for direct compound-protein engagement
queries.Context: Quantitative measurement of pro: TMT-based quantitative proteomics coupled with mass spectrometry for proteome-wide protein quantification in thermal shift assays measuring compound-induced thermal stability changes in K562 cells and lysates for drug mechanism of action characterization
queries.Context: Interpretation strategy for dis: comparative cell-based and lysate-based PISA proteome-wide thermal shift assays for distinguishing direct ligand binding from indirect cellular effects in drug mechanism of action
queries.Context: Assay parameter optimization fo: Optimization of a 48 to 58 degree Celsius thermal window in PISA proteome-wide thermal shift assays to maximize protein fold-change detection while covering the descending portion of melting curves in K562 cells using TMT mass spectrometry
queries.Context: Chemical library construction f: curated chemical library of cancer drugs and tool compounds with annotated targets and known mechanisms of action for proteome-wide thermal shift assay screening of drug mechanism of action in K562 cells and lysates
queries.Context: Chemical library composition ac: PISA proteome-wide thermal shift assay screening of chemical libraries with protein kinase, HDAC, lysine demethylase, and PARP inhibitors for drug mechanism of action characterization in K562 cells by TMT mass spectrometry
queries.Context: Primary cell-based screening co: primary screen of K562 cells treated with compounds at 10 μM for 30 minutes in biological duplicate for proteome-wide thermal shift assay and compound mechanism of action
queries.Context: Multiplexed proteomics executio: TMTPro 16-plex quantitative proteomics for high-throughput PISA thermal shift screening of small molecule compounds in K562 cells to characterize drug mechanism of action and off-target protein engagement
queries.Context: Lysate-based screening of selec: Proteome-wide thermal shift assay screening of selected small molecule compounds in K562 cell lysates using PISA, TMT quantitative proteomics, and thermal stability profiling to identify direct protein target engagement and mechanism of action
queries.Context: Statistical filtering of therma: Empirical statistical filtering criteria for high-confidence thermal stability changes in PISA proteome-wide thermal shift assays, requiring log2 fold change and protein-specific variance thresholds across compound treatments
queries.Context: Validation of thermal stability: Dose-response experiments validating compound-induced protein thermal stability changes against compound potency in proteome-wide thermal shift assays, including PISA, CETSA, and TPP, to assess target engagement and direct binding in cells and lysates.
queries.Context: Orthogonal validation of predic: biochemical assays and western blotting for orthogonal validation of predicted small molecule target engagement and downstream signaling effects in K562 cells during drug mechanism of action characterization
queries.Context: Systems-level analysis of relat: network-based correlation analysis of compound-induced proteome-wide thermal shift assay profiles to identify coordinated thermal stability responses among structurally related proteins and protein complexes for drug mechanism of action
queries.Context: Specificity and off-target anal: Proteome-wide thermal shift profiling comparing compounds with shared targets to assess drug specificity and identify off-target protein interactions using PISA thermal stability measurements
